description: Write the release details for a track or album as a DRAFT. A draft costs nothing, can be changed and goes nowhere until the artist says so. Returns a draft_hash identifying exactly what you prepared, and release_rules: everything the track or album still needs to meet the stores' rules (master format, cover, sub-genre, languages, countries, performer roles) before it can be submitted. An older track or album usually needs some of it.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

release.description: The release fields, by the names get_requirements(entity: "release") gives them, for example { "release_type": "single", "scheduled_date": "2026-11-20", "description": "...", "pitching_directly": "...", "release_timeline": "...", "artist_quotes": "..." }. Add "splits" for royalty splits. Send only what you are setting.

name: save_release_draft
title: Prepare a release, as a draft
